subject: Acme procurement & security qualification — post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme procurement & security qualification — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks for the call earlier today — great to meet the procurement and security team. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

1) Procurement path: you mentioned procurement prefers PO-based purchases and a monthly billing cadence. Can you confirm whether a PO (net 30) is required for initial purchase or if a company card is acceptable for the pilot?

2) Marketplace: you asked about AWS Marketplace / Cloud marketplace options. We support AWS Marketplace AMI/Private Offers and can enable that for predictable procurement — happy to introduce our partner lead if you'd like.

3) Security/compliance gating: next items to unblock procurement we noted: SOC 2 report (summary + controls map), signed DPA, and your vendor security questionnaire. We can share a SOC 2 summary and a DPA draft right away; for the questionnaire, can you send the spreadsheet and point of contact on your side?

4) Timeline: from our side we can assemble SOC2 summary and DPA draft by EOD tomorrow and have a solutions-eng review in parallel. If legal needs 2–3 business days for redlines, we can align timing with your procurement sprint.

Next steps I propose:
- I will share SOC 2 summary + DPA draft (attached) — action: Marissa (today)
- Dev to provide brief note on network/data flow & support for marketplace (cc’d) — action: Dev (tomorrow)
- Please send vendor questionnaire and point of contact — action: Jordan/Priya

Thanks — we want to make this as frictionless as possible for your procurement team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF)] [Attachment: DPA-draft-Acme.docx (DOCX)]

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security qualification — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks Marissa — quick clarifications from Procurement: 

- Procurement preference: PO (net 30) for anything beyond the POC. For the pilot, we can put a company card on file if Redwood supports card billing for month-to-month. If not, we'll route a short PO for the pilot.

- Marketplace: yes, AWS Marketplace would be preferred for our procurement flows. Can you confirm whether Redwood can issue private offers and whether billing/usage will appear on our Marketplace invoice?

- SOC 2 / DPA: please send the SOC2 summary and DPA draft (we'll share internally). Our legal will likely redline the DPA; timeline depends on their queue but estimate ~3–5 business days after we receive the draft.

I'll attach our standard vendor questionnaire — that will be the gating doc for Security. Priya will manage the security intake.

Jordan
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
[jordan.lee@acme.com]

On Tue, Jun 22, 2027 at 08:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for your time...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security qualification — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks Jordan — confirmed on our side:

- Billing options: we support both card billing for month-to-month pilots and PO/net-30 for committed contracts. For pilots on card we recommend a small monthly commitment to avoid provisioning delays; if you prefer PO, we'll accept net-30 POs and can start provisioning once PO is received.

- AWS Marketplace: we do support private offers and can surface usage on Marketplace invoices. I'll loop our partnerships lead if you want a Marketplace agreement; otherwise we can proceed via PO.

- SOC 2 / DPA: attaching SOC 2 summary and a standard Redwood DPA (see attachments). Rishi is our security lead and can answer any control-level questions; Dev is cc'd for technical evidence (network diagrams, landing zone details).

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, DPA-draft-Acme.docx

Please confirm who on your side will own the vendor questionnaire and an expected target for completion. If you want, we can set up a 30-minute sync with our security team to walk through any high-priority items.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF)] [Attachment: DPA-draft-Acme.docx (DOCX)]

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security qualification — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks — I’m the owner for the vendor questionnaire. I’ve attached our questionnaire in XLSX. A few notes from Security: 

- SOC 2 summary is helpful; we will still request the full controls mapping and evidence for scoped controls (e.g., encryption at rest, key management, access reviews). Please confirm expected delivery for those artifacts.

- DPA: we will expect your legal redlines; timeline depends on our legal queue but we can expedite once we have the draft.

- Marketplace: Marketplace billing is preferred but not mandatory. If Redwood can present a private offer so it shows up on Marketplace billing, that reduces internal procurement friction.

Our target: we’d like to complete the questionnaire within 7 business days if possible — primary blocker is evidence collection on Redwood side.

Attaching: acme-security-questionnaire.xlsx

Priya Shah
Information Security Lead, Acme Corp
[priya.shah@acme.com]

On Tue, Jun 22, 2027 at 11:30 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Jordan — confirmed on our side...

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security qualification — post-call recap and next steps

Hi Priya / Marissa — quick technical notes to support the questionnaire and evidence request:

- SOC 2 evidence & controls map: we can provide a controls mapping export and sample evidence (policy PDFs, screenshot of audit logging, sample access review). ETA: we can collect and share scoped evidence within 3 business days after we get the specific control list you need (or we can share the full controls pack if easier).

- Encryption & key management: we use customer-managed keys (optional) via KMS integrations for private deployments; hosted customers use Redwood-managed KMS with AES-256 at rest.

- Marketplace: we support private offers that flow through AWS Marketplace; billing will show as a Marketplace line item — recommend Marketplace for enterprise procurement ease.

- Point of contact: for technical evidence please loop me (dev_patel@redwood.ai) and Rishi for security clarifications. For legal/DPA redlines, loop Stephanie (stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai) as Sales Ops / Legal coordinator.

Happy to schedule a 30-minute evidence walk-through once you confirm which controls are in-scope.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai

[Attachment: acme-security-questionnaire.xlsx (received)]
